procedures.name: COS_NEEDCALSYNC
procedures.source:
DECLARE VARIABLE ID_CAL INTEGER;
DECLARE VARIABLE RESULT INTEGER;
begin
  begin
    for select distinct cc.id from cos_calend cc
        where cc.idprac = :idprac /* vsechny kalendare pracoviste and cc.iduzi = :iduzi */
        into :id_cal
    do begin
      if (:datum is null) then begin
        delete from COS_CALEND_SYNC cs
        where cs.idcal = :id_cal;
        insert into COS_CALEND_SYNC (idcal, datum, needsync)
        values(:id_cal, NULL, 'T');
      end else begin
        if (not exists (select idcal from COS_CALEND_SYNC
                        where idcal=:id_cal and datum=:datum and needsync='T'))
        then begin
          insert into COS_CALEND_SYNC (idcal, datum, needsync)
          values(:id_cal, :datum, 'T');
        end
      end
    end
    RESULT = 0;
  when any do
    RESULT = 1;
  end
end
